args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Rollback completed successfully; monitoring for recovery.

trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api was failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions, with an error rate of 0.18.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Investigated** — `get_service_status` confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). `list_deployments` showed the release history: v2.2.9 (healthy), v2.3.0 (healthy), v2.3.1 (unhealthy), plus a staging-only v2.3.1-rc (unhealthy).
2. **Rolled back** — Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production, across all regions. The rollback completed successfully.
3. **Opened incident** — Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the failure and the rollback. (The API returned a transient 502, but I verified via `list_incidents` that the incident was created and is open.)

**Verification:** Post-rollback status shows checkout-api on v2.3.0 in all regions, **healthy**, with error rate down to 0.002.
